answer_2.quote: We report precision (P), recall (R), and F1 computed by these scoring functions.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 100 sentences from the CaRB validation set... we ask two graduate CS students, blind to the OpenIE systems, to mark each triple for correctness (0 or 1) ... They also label extractions for compactness (0 or 1).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators mark each extracted triple for correctness (whether it is asserted in the text and captures the semantic information) and for compactness (whether none of its constituents is longer than 10 words, includes conjunction, or can be an independent extraction).
